subject.title: feat(subagents): native announceTarget for subagent completion routing (#27445)

question: Should OpenClaw adopt caller-selectable parent completion routing as a permanent sessions_spawn argument plus global and per-agent defaults with durable replay and no channel fallback?
rationale: Tests and live proof establish implementation correctness, but they cannot choose the breadth of the permanent model-facing API, configuration contract, stored-state semantics, or user-visible failure policy.

options.title: Sponsor per-spawn routing
options.body: Approve a narrower explicit sessions_spawn argument with durable per-run state, without global or per-agent configuration defaults.

options.title: Sponsor full contract
options.body: Approve the tool argument, both configuration defaults, durable replay, and no-channel-fallback behavior as proposed.

options.title: Decline native routing
options.body: Keep current channel behavior and leave future handoff design in the canonical feature discussion.

recommendation.title: Sponsor per-spawn routing
recommendation.body: Approve a narrower explicit sessions_spawn argument with durable per-run state, without global or per-agent configuration defaults.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest merged-history connection to the native spawn API, adjacent orchestration behavior, and state architecture involved in this decision.
